script: Spread and total were not saved, so this is form-only: Kansas City has been a Kenneth Walker game (65 carries, 360 yards, 5.54 YPC in weeks 1-3) with Patrick Mahomes more efficient vs the blitz (0.41 EPA/dropback, n=27) than without (0.19). Las Vegas has fed Ashton Jeanty 63 carries for only 206 yards (3.27 YPC) and Tre Tucker 189 yards on 228 air yards. Expect KC to keep the Walker workload into a run defense allowing 4.47 YPC, with throws concentrated on Travis Kelce (231 yards, 18 targets) and Rashee Rice (190 yards, 17 targets) rather than a shootout script.
who_goes_off: Kenneth Walker is the carry who should go off: 21.7 carries and 120.0 rush yards per game into a Las Vegas defense that has allowed 4.47 YPC and 8 runs of 10-plus. Travis Kelce is the pass answer, 77.0 yards per game on 18 targets, into the only Raiders passing zone above 9 yards per attempt.
weak_spot: Las Vegas's real hole is the middle, 9.83 YPA on 12 attempts, versus 7.26 left (39 att) and 5.91 right (45 att), plus a soft front at 4.47 YPC. Kansas City's hole is the same lane: 10.0 YPA on 20 middle attempts, against 5.26 left (39 att) and 4.06 right (36 att), with only 5 gains of 20-plus allowed on 99 pass attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for KC at LV, so nothing in the numbers moves usage off the week 1-3 leaders: Walker 65 carries and 18 targets, Kelce 18 targets, Rice 17 targets, Jeanty 63 carries and 17 targets, Tucker 15 targets, Brock Bowers only 13 targets for 116 yards.
qb_vs_blitz: Patrick Mahomes is +0.41 EPA/dropback vs the blitz (n=27) and +0.19 when Las Vegas does not blitz, but the Raiders have blitzed on only 21% of dropbacks, so most of this game is the lesser +0.19 look. Kirk Cousins is +0.11 vs the blitz (n=30) and +0.16 without it; Kansas City's 31% blitz rate is a small drag on LV, not a collapse.

picks.why: Walker is at 120.0 rush yards per game on 21.7 carries and 5.54 YPC, against an 86.5 line. Repriced to Las Vegas's 4.47 YPC allowed, 21 carries is about 94 yards; a cut to 18 carries at his own 5.54 YPC is still 99.7. Both clear 86.5, and LV has already allowed 8 runs of 10-plus.

Kelce has 231 yards on 18 targets, 77.0 per game and 12.8 yards per target, versus a 47.5 line. Las Vegas has allowed 9.83 YPA in the middle on 12 attempts, their worst zone, and they blitz only 21%, so Mahomes is not forced off that window. He needs about a 40% target cut at the same efficiency just to land on 47.5.
